usbMount.description:
Where the phone is mounted over the cable (aft-mtp-mount). The folder must exist and be yours:
  sudo mkdir -p /mnt/android && sudo chown $USER /mnt/android

Takes a path. Default: "/mnt/android".

open.x-wants: a command as a list of texts, like ["kitty", "-e", "yazi"]
open.description:
What opens a mounted phone. `{path}` is the mount point; with no `{path}` in the list it is added at the end.

Takes a command as a list of texts, like ["kitty", "-e", "yazi"]. Default: ["kitty","-o","background_opacity=0.75","--title","yazi","yazi","{path}"].

sendDir.description:
Where on the phone "Send" puts what you pick (adb push).

Takes a path. Default: "/sdcard/Download".

pickDir.description:
The folder "Send" starts its file chooser in.

Takes a path. Default: "~".

usb.description: scrcpy over the cable: the phone's own resolution, scrcpy's own bit rate and frame rate. 0 / "" leave scrcpy's default.

wifi.description: scrcpy over Wi-Fi: lighter, so it stays smooth. maxSize is the longest side in pixels, bitRate e.g. "6M".

recordDir.description:
Where a recording goes (the Record switch): phone-<date>-<time>.mp4 here.

Takes a path. Default: "~/Videos".

extraArgs.description:
Any further scrcpy arguments, added last, e.g. ["--window-borderless"].

Takes a list of texts. Default: [].

start.description:
When the adb server is started. "onDemand": when you ask for something that needs it. "onPlug": also when a phone with USB
debugging comes onto the cable. The tool stops a server it started itself after `idleKillS` seconds of no need.

Takes "onDemand" or "onPlug". Default: "onDemand".

port.description:
The port `arm` opens on the phone (adb tcpip). Wi-Fi mirroring tries each address KDE Connect reports with this port, so a
changed IP needs no setup: nothing here is an address, and no address is ever written down.

Takes a whole number 1024 .. 65535. Default: 5555.

dir.description:
Where "Screenshot" saves phone-<date>-<time>.png.

Takes a path. Default: "~/Pictures/Screenshots".

onOpen.description:
The phone turns once, front to front, every time the popup opens.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

closeAfterS.description:
The popup's cast (Mirror on the phone's own screen) keeps running this long after the popup closes, so a quick look
away costs nothing; then it stops. Seconds.

Takes a whole number 5 .. 86400. Default: 120.

reloadOnResize.description:
A resized Mirror restarts its stream at the new size, so the picture is sharp at every size; the last frame is held,
blurred, while it does (a second or two). false: the stream keeps the size it started at and is scaled. A Desktop never
restarts for a size (its apps would go).

Takes true or false. Default: true.

desktopScale.description:
The Desktop mode's virtual screen is laid out like a laptop's: `desktopScale` is how many pixels of THIS screen one Android dp
gets (1.0: a dp is about a pixel of the picture; 2.0 makes everything on the phone's desktop half as big). 0.5 to 3.

Takes a number 0.5 .. 3. Default: 1.

desktopMinDp.description:
...but the virtual screen's short side is never fewer than this many dp (apps switch to their phone layouts below ~600 dp
wide; 320 is a phone). 240 to 1200.

Takes a whole number 240 .. 1200. Default: 320.

desktopMinPx.description:
...and never fewer than this many PIXELS: the phone's own second launcher lays its icons out in pixels, ignores the screen's
density, and its icons overlap below ~600 px of short side. 320 to 2400.

Takes a whole number 320 .. 2400. Default: 640.

unlock.description:
When the kept PIN unlocks a locked phone: "start+touch" (as you start a cast, and as you touch the picture of a locked phone) | "start" |
"touch" | "never".

Takes "start+touch", "start", "touch" or "never". Default: "start+touch".

keys.description:
The keys that are the phone's Back, Home and Recents while the picture has the keyboard (Qt's key names: "Left", "F1", "PageUp" ...). "" =
none: that key goes to the phone as it is.

sleepAtEnd.description:
The phone's screen goes off when a cast ends (only if the cast lit it).

Takes true or false. Default: true.

holdMin.description:
How long a cast may keep the phone awake on the charger without being renewed, minutes. 1 to 240.

Takes a number 1 .. 240. Default: 30.

relight.description:
The body's highlights follow the light of the room (the shell's relight of the phone's frame).

Takes true or false. Default: true.

lookKey.description:
The key that is held for the free look (the phone turns with the pointer): "alt" | "ctrl" | "shift" | "off".

Takes "alt", "ctrl", "shift" or "off". Default: "alt".

devices.description:
Per device, by its name or its key (kdc:<id> / adb:<serial>): a skin to draw ("redmagic-10s-pro-moonlight" or "generic"; the
name decides when this says nothing), and `hidden` to keep a device out of the list.
  "devices": { "REDMAGIC 10S Pro": { "skin": "redmagic-10s-pro-moonlight" }, "kdc:abc123": { "hidden": true } }

Default: {}.
